full_judgment: 25. PW 5 Shamsuddin is the sister's husband of the informant PW 1 and he was also undisputedly injured in the occurrence and he was examined by PW 9 Dr. Nawab Ali Khan who stated that he was EMO, Medical College Hospital, Mymensingh and on 20.11.86 at 3-00 PM he found on examination one penetrating wound 1/2" x1/2" on the left chest, another penetrating wound on the front side of the left thigh and another penetrating wound on the left upper arms which were caused by sharp pointed weapon. Thus undoubtedly PW 3, 4 and 5 were the eye-witnesses and victims of the occurrence and were thus competent persons to speak not only as to which of the accused assaulted them and others, but in what manner.
